summary: Critical outage in inventory-service caused by capacity_traffic (INC-0028)
description: Service inventory-service incident INC-0028. Symptoms: HTTP 502 Bad Gateway under surge. Error: RateLimitExceeded: Maximum concurrency limit 5000 requests/sec reached. Root cause was capacity_traffic. Followed runbook RB-bad-deploy-rollback.

comments.author: devops1
comments.body: Restarted service pods for inventory-service and applied RB-bad-deploy-rollback.
